description: This header defines the class AOTInductorModel within the torch::aot_inductor namespace. It includes declarations for constructors, model execution methods, and a factory method. It serves as an interface for an AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) inductor model used in PyTorch's code generation scope.

classes.name: AOTInductorModel
classes.description: A class inheriting from AOTInductorModelBase, representing a model used in the AOT inductor framework, with methods for running and creating model instances.
